findings.summary: Two accepted ADRs name different sole producers of the sovereign corpus, and both producers run at the pins. ADR-2013 Decision 3 makes VisionClaw crates/vault the only parser, reasoner and build. ADR-2014's estate alignment and visionGraph's workflow make ontomark the only producer. VisionClaw's ontology-publish workflow still builds with vault. ADR-2013 is not marked superseded or amended.
findings.consequence: Canon gives contradictory guidance on the highest-leverage consolidation in the estate (retiring vault, parallel-implementations.md:511). Consumers can load generations built by two compilers whose public gates and reasoners differ (ONT-02, ONT-04).
findings.finding_and_consequence: Two accepted ADRs name different sole producers of the sovereign corpus, and both producers run at the pins. VisionClaw's ontology-publish workflow still builds with vault. ADR-2013 is not marked superseded or amended.
